items.title: Novavax Eyes New Partnerships as Sanofi Advances COVID-Flu Vaccine Trial
items.summary: Novavax (NASDAQ:NVAX) is looking to expand partnerships around its vaccine technology while advancing a potential C. difficile vaccine and supporting partner Sanofi’s development of a combination COVID-19 and flu shot, executives said at the Jefferies 2026 Global Healthcare Conference in London. items.title: A 67-Year-Old With $750,000 in Pfizer, Enterprise Products and UPS Collects $3,765 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, a hypothetical $750,000 portfolio split evenly across Pfizer, Enterprise Products Partners and UPS pays about $45,200 a year in dividends, or about $3,760 a month. Enterprise Products Partners’ distribution looks the safest of the three, covered 1.

items.title: Wall Street Forgot These 3 Dividend Stocks — Now They Pay Over 5%
items.summary: A drugmaker, a telecom giant, and a consumer lender all pay more than most investors expect, yet the market keeps looking away. One of them carries a risk that could turn its payout into a trap.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson vs. Pfizer: Consistency vs. Volatility in Revenue
items.summary: J&J's quarterly sales have climbed with few setbacks, while Pfizer's have swung between $13.7 billion and $17.8 billion over eight quarters.

items.title: Conagra Cut Its Dividend 50%. The Stock Market Was Warning Investors
items.summary: Conagra's falling stock price told one story while its board told another, and the board lost. Four more high-yield payers are sending the same mixed signals, and one cash flow line shows which side to believe.

items.title: 5 “Forever Income” Dividend Stocks Yielding 5% and More for Boomers
items.summary: Two of these retirement income payers slashed their dividends in 2020, and one more cut years earlier. Before you trust any of them with your paycheck, see which safety test each stock passes and which risk could still bite.

items.title: Pfizer CEO: ‘China will be my major competition by 2030’
items.summary: Albert Bourla’s comments come a month after the Chinese government unveiled a five-year biomedical plan to grow its pharma exports.
